system: Shadowrun 5th Edition — Life Modules Character Creation

skills.skill_group_expansion: Each Skill Group rank adds +1 to every member Active Skill defined in skill_groups.json (SR5 Core; Biotechnology includes Biotechnology, Cybertechnology, First Aid, and Medicine).
skills.skill_cap_rollover_rule: Active skills that go above the chargen cap (7) from Life Modules roll over to other skills in the same Skill Group. If the skill is not in a Skill Group (or all skills in its group are at cap), the rollover instead goes to another active skill with the same linked attribute.
skills.placeholder_knowledge_skills: Knowledge skills in [brackets] (is_placeholder=true) are placeholders; during character creation, the player chooses a specific knowledge skill or language matching that description.

Friends in High Places.note: Grants an extra CHA * 4 Contact Karma pool dedicated to Contacts with Connection 8-12 (cannot spend extra Karma on them, and unspent points are lost).

Networker.note: Reduces the cost of each Contact purchased by 1 point/Karma (minimum 1).

Massive Network.note: Reduces the cost of each Contact purchased by 2 points/Karma (minimum 2).

Made Man.note: Grants a free Crime Syndicate Group Contact at Loyalty 3 (+10% syndicate fence price, -10% syndicate gear discount).

Prime Datahaven Membership.note: Grants a free Datahaven Group Contact (Connection 5, effective Loyalty 3 for datahaven use).

Black Market Pipeline.note: Designate one Contact for a chosen gear category: +2 dice to Availability tests, -10% cost, and +1 effective Connection and +1 effective Loyalty when sourcing those goods.

Sensei.note: Requires a designated Contact whose Connection >= your instructed skill rating; reduces active skill/group training time and Karma cost by 1 (min 1).

Home Ground (You Know a Guy).note: Home Ground (You Know a Guy) (SR5 p. 75): In your chosen Home Ground neighborhood, local NPCs have a Friendly attitude toward you by default (unless given reason not to), and you gain +2 Street Cred for any Negotiation test with someone from that neighborhood.

Privileged Family Name.note: Family name recognition acts as a leverage/reputation modifier (+1 Social Limit with high society/corps, -2 Intimidation defense from authorities).

Trustworthy.note: +2 Social Limit when convincing others of honesty/trustworthiness and +1 Influence skill group.

Solid Rep.note: +1 Street Cred within a chosen community/group, improving initial disposition with contacts in that circle.

Bad Rep.note: +3 Notoriety; contacts and strangers aware of your reputation suffer negative social disposition.

Candle in the Darkness.note: Requires a Code of Honor negative quality. While upholding your Code of Honor, all Contacts are treated as having Loyalty +2 higher than their actual rating; if broken, all Contacts are treated as having Loyalty -1 lower until corrected.

Ex-Con.note: Corporate contacts will only associate with you if they have Loyalty 4+; Law Enforcement contacts only stick by you if they have Loyalty 5 or 6.

positive_exempt_from_limit: Positive qualities gained from Life Modules
Mastery qualities (subtype of positive qualities primarily from Forbidden Arcana and the Neon-Anarchist sourcebook playtest)
negative_counts_against_limit: Negative qualities gained from Life Modules
Negative qualities purchased manually outside modules
qualities.negative_overflow_rule: It is legal to exceed 25 Karma of negative qualities via Life Modules alone. If module negative qualities total >= 25 Karma, the character cannot select any additional negative qualities after choosing modules (remaining manual negative quality allowance = max(0, 25 - module_negative_karma)).
qualities.duplicate_quality_rule: If you receive the same quality twice across modules and it cannot advance to a higher tier, select another quality of the same Karma cost.
qualities.negative_quality_buyoff: You may buy off negative qualities obtained from Life Modules using extra Karma.
qualities.sinner_stacking: SINner qualities from modules do not stack; only the highest-severity SINner applies (National 5 < Criminal 10 < Corporate Limited 15 < Corporate 25).

nationality_and_formative_years.description: Nationality + Formative Years cover up to 10 years old.

teen_years.description: Teen Years age the character to 17 years old.

stage_selection_rules.Further Education: Single choice (max 1), with two exceptions: (1) You may take a Community College or Trade School module and then also take a State University or Ivy League module; (2) One Student Athlete module may be added to any selection or selections of Further Education modules.
stage_selection_rules.Real Life: Unlimited — players may take as many Real Life modules as they can afford.

tour_of_duty_rank.description: When starting a Tour of Duty module: if you have the Rank quality at the 5 Karma level, you are an NCO; if you have the Rank quality at the 20 Karma level, you are an Officer.
